scope: Internal hardware experiment on AMD Radeon 8060S. Node reranker tuning and held-out numerical references, followed by transfer to a distinct browser document-search application and excluded corpus.

unlimited.scope: All retained successful warmup/timed tuning/heldout runs; use evaluator ranges for selection.

bounded.scope: All retained successful warmup/timed tuning/heldout runs; use evaluator ranges for selection.

limitations: The lower memory policy increases opening time.
Only one physical GPU configuration is measured.
Node process peak RSS and sampled browser renderer RSS have different scopes.
Public replay machinery is provided; an independent full replay run is tracked separately.
